video_title: Tony Allen called out LeBron James... and we ADDRESS IT 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen's criticism of LeBron James' defensive assignments
quotes.excerpt: Tony Allen had an issue with LeBron being ranked 22 on the all-time defenders ahead of him.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Tony Allen had an issue with LeBron being ranked 22 on the all-time defenders ahead of him because he said LeBron didn't stick the best matchup every single night. LeBron would just kind of at the end of the game stick the best matchup.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: He also said LeBron was a guy you would hunt.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Yeah, that's what he said as well.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' defensive legacy and guarding elite players
quotes.excerpt: LeBron, you've been in all them Finals, you had all them runs, you went through all them Eastern Conferences.
quotes.quote: LeBron, you've been in all them Finals, you had all them runs, you went through all them Eastern Conferences. You're going to act like LeBron never had to guard nobody? So DeRozan's nobody? Paul George is nobody? You're out there. So it's not like these people are your assignments because you have Shane Battier and people like that your whole career to Shumpert on Cleveland. But if you're out there with all the pick-and-rolls and stuff that's going on, you mean to tell me LeBron is not guarding nobody? He's not strapping down when he has to in order to make all of these Finals? It's irresponsible to say LeBron James is a better defender than Tony Allen.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Debating if LeBron James is a better defender than Tony Allen
quotes.excerpt: So you're saying LeBron James is a better defender than Tony Allen?
quotes.quote: So you're saying LeBron James is a better defender than Tony Allen? He's had to defend more than Tony Allen, yes.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Allen's role coming off the bench in Boston
quotes.excerpt: Tony Allen was coming off the bench in Boston.
quotes.quote: Tony Allen was coming off the bench in Boston. So how could you have the assignment of guarding LeBron? You're talking about Memphis. You forgot he had Z-Bo there and fucking Gasol. How many playoff runs did Memphis have that he had to guard somebody? You're talking about four or five. You forgot he had Z-Bo there and fucking Gasol.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Bryant's assessment of post defenders
quotes.excerpt: And he called Kendrick Perkins the best post defender ever.
quotes.quote: And he called Kendrick Perkins the best post defender ever. We listening to everything Kobe say? Kobe said he was a great post defender. When he played on the Celtics before his ACL, he was a great post defender.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Curry's defensive assignments and Tony Allen
quotes.excerpt: Steph Curry said Tony Allen's one of the guys he didn't want to see the most.
quotes.quote: Steph Curry said Tony Allen's one of the guys he didn't want to see the most on his defensive assignments. Tony Allen was known as a defender. That was his job. That was his reputation. Everybody can say what they want, but was LeBron's block on Tiago Splitter a chase-down?

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton's experience playing with LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: I've been on this couch probably the most series with LeBron against.
quotes.quote: I've been on this couch probably the most series with LeBron against. He's not guarding the best player nightly. I don't know where you're seeing that clip at. That's not the case. That's not his assignment to guard the best player, but when you're out there, it's not about that. His matchup was the best wing player every single night, Josh. That's his point.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' offensive responsibility versus defensive assignment
quotes.excerpt: Because you wasn't responsible for scoring 30, 10, and 8.
quotes.quote: Because you wasn't responsible for scoring 30, 10, and 8. That's fine. You're right. I wouldn't put that on him. But you know who Paul George was? Paul George got the best guy on each team. Kawhi Leonard goes to guard the other best player. Jaylen Brown goes to guard the other best player. Anthony Edwards, you see the usage rate players ever. LeBron, Harden, people like that. You're not going to be known to do the defensive stuff, but you still got to do it because it goes. Go look at Kobe. Kobe guarded more guys than Bron did.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' lack of defensive breaks
quotes.excerpt: You never get the rest. LeBron never got no breaks on defense.
quotes.quote: You never get the rest. LeBron never got no breaks on defense. Oh, I'm going to go ahead and tell you this. I don't think you can confidently say that because I'm going to be real with you. Yes, there's a lot of responsibility for offensive guys, but I've been in a locker room with Donyell Marshall, Reggie Bullock, guys that are 3-and-D guys. Them motherfuckers work hard, dog. It's not easy just going out there guarding the best player. Think about being Tony Allen and having to guard Kevin Durant the first night, then Stephen Curry the next night.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Hypothetical coaching instruction for Tony Allen
quotes.excerpt: If the coach said, you know what Tony Allen, take a break and guard Draymond tonight.
quotes.quote: If the coach said, you know what Tony Allen, take a break and guard Draymond tonight. We need 30 from you. Could he do that? Tony Allen's job was to be on the court to guard.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' defensive capabilities and responsibilities
quotes.excerpt: LeBron is capable of guarding anybody.
quotes.quote: We talking about capabilities. LeBron is capable of guarding anybody. But that's not what he's doing. That's not what he's had to do for his career. If my responsibility is to lead the team in points, rebounds, and assists, I'm sorry, motherfucker, somebody else do something. You guard.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' defensive focus during the Miami Heat years
quotes.excerpt: The year LeBron said that shit about Marcus Smart, he dedicated something else to the other side.
quotes.quote: The year LeBron said that shit about Marcus Smart, he dedicated something else to the other side of the ball that year he feels. So that's what he's talking about. Like Miami Heat was one of the best defensive teams, was they not? I'm waiting for somebody that played ball to answer because y'all was there on the court. LeBron was in defending y'all. Y'all right there, Charlie. You was there. The LeBron ain't stepping in front of you. He's a slouch?
